CVE-2019-11596.title: In memcached before 1.5.14, a NULL pointer dereference was found  ...
CVE-2019-11596.description: In memcached before 1.5.14, a NULL pointer dereference was found in the "lru mode" and "lru temp_ttl" commands. This causes a denial of service when parsing crafted lru command messages in process_lru_command in memcached.c.
